fullBio: Genre bending, mind winding, groovy instrumentals

After releasing the debut 12" vinyl "Mellow Toning" in 2025 and the live comilation CD "All Are Welcome" in 2026, Tinynormous is currently taking some time off to write and record, but will return to the stage in early 2027 leading up to another Analog Avalon Festival in the coming Summer!
notableHighlights: We believe in the live experience. None of our music is on streaming platforms. We'd rather you come to a show and maybe pick up a CD or vinyl while saying hi
2026 was a wild ride and we are currently writing and recording a very special soundtrack project. Details soon!
Some of our favorite shows are available on our youtube channel
We can't wait to dshow on what we're working, but you've gotta be patient. We promise it'll be worth the wait :)
